headline: Castel succession: Singapore High Court upholds ouster of IBBM executives
summary: Judge Philip Jeyaretnam of the Singapore High Court validated resolutions by Romy Castel and allies to remove the main IBBM executives, according to judgment grounds dated November 20, 2026. The ruling is a key step in the Castel group succession battle.
why: Castel is a family-controlled wine and spirits group, and leadership disputes can affect its governance, strategy and asset decisions.
original_headline: Succession chez Castel : la Haute Cour de Singapour valide l’éviction des dirigeants d’IBBM
